answer_1.quote: This paper proposes Text Style Transfer Back Translation (TST BT) to further enhance BT effectiveness.
answer_1.outputs: The paper generates synthetic parallel data through back translation and applies text style transfer to improve naturalness of machine-translated source text, aiming to enhance neural machine translation outputs for natural inputs.

answer_2.quote: We use metrics including BLEU , ChrF , COMET  and BLEURT  to evaluate models performances on test sets.

answer_4.quote: We randomly sample 300 sentences from WMT17-19 original and reverse test sets respectively. We follow the evaluation scheme mentioned by , and 8 professional annotators are recruited to rate adequacy and fluency of three MT results on a 5-point scale, given source text and reference.
answer_4.guideline: 8 professional annotators are recruited to rate adequacy and fluency of three MT results on a 5-point scale, given source text and reference.
